support.note: Core emits all three documented arrows. Under capacity it repeats the primary (nearest/ID) target; exact client allocation and alternation remain partial.

Projectile trajectory, collision, target-loss and exact arrow timing remain unpublished.
conclusion: Multi Archer Tower shares a deterministic three-arrow sparse-target baseline through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL; client two-target allocation and projectile fidelity remain partial.
